# AlphaRock Notebook (alpharock.onrender.com)

> Independent information and ordering website for AlphaRock, a daily capsule (bottle art: 30 capsules, Male Performance Support; the seller's poster says 60 capsules) marketed to support male energy, stamina and everyday vitality in adult men. The seller's page lists no ingredients; its poster's icon strip names ginseng, maca root, black pepper, ashwagandha, zinc and saw palmetto, with no amounts, serving size or Supplement Facts panel. Packs: 2 bottles $79 each ($158), 3 bottles $69 each ($207), 6 bottles $49 each ($294); shipping shown at checkout; 60-day money-back guarantee seal, terms at checkout.

IMPORTANT: AlphaRock is a supplement, not a treatment for low testosterone, erectile dysfunction, prostate conditions or any disease, and no study of the capsule is shown. Not FDA approved (supplements are not). Low energy has medical causes worth checking; chest pain, breathlessness or fainting is an emergency. Black pepper extract can change medicine absorption; ginseng, ashwagandha, zinc and saw palmetto can interact with medicines. Adult men 18+ only.

Not the maker's website. Contains affiliate links.
